notes.title: Gunlok is back!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36293987/ea753c184202f3a67312f910eb6da0447d1cad43.png[/img]

At the end of the 21st Century, robots finally enslaved mankind. You are Gunlok, a member of Earth’s Special Forces. Isolated during the robots’ uprising, it’s time to strike back in this team-based tactics game!

Blasting out from the Rebellion games archive!

Available now!
